context.passage:
Bright Beach Lodge on the North Coast

The North Coast is famous for more than its soft, sandy beaches and crystal-clear
waters. Thousands of visitors flock to its summer weekend festivals or hike the trails
at nearby Great Gramble Forest, the only national park in the province. For the best
accommodations on the North Coast, look no further than Bright Beach Lodge.

Bright Beach Lodge's main building houses ten comfortable guest suites, each with a
king-size bed and full bath. There are also eight two-bedroom cabins and six
three-bedroom cabins on the property. Each cabin has a fully equipped eat-in
kitchen, a living room with a fireplace, and a patio with a barbecue grill and picnic
table. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the 12-hectare property.

A menities include a private beach, two playgrounds, a communal fire pit, and
benches with great views of the sunset. Beach umbrellas and chairs, sand toys,
bicycles, fishing equipment, and ocean kayaks are all available for rent. Bright Beach
Lodge is open from May 15 to October 15.

Daily rates are as follows: $200.00 for a guest suite, $350.00 for a two-bedroom cabin,
and $400.00 for a three-bedroom cabin.

For more information or to book your stay, please visit www.brightbeachlodge.net.
